title: Dolphin Launches DeepSeek V4.1 Flash API at 97% Lower Cost
summary:
The first 1,000 users to sign up for a new artificial intelligence tool are receiving $30 in free credits to test its agentic and coding capabilities. The Dolphin Inference API is now live, utilizing DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to provide performance on par with Opus 5 models. This infrastructure allows developers to run operations at a cost that is 97% lower than that of other frontier models.

The service targets software builders who require direct API access rather than the monthly subscription plans used by general consumers. Some industry observers suggest that subsidized monthly planos for inference are unsustainable, creating a need for market-priced options like the system developed by Dolphin.
